I need a formal Notice of Material Breach to Highline Milling freezing their $85,000 monthly account and threatening termination. Due before 2:00 PM. Can you help me get the wording right?

Here is a formal, legally structured draft tailored to Vance’s directive. It clearly asserts material breach, suspends the $85,000 monthly retainer/payment, establishes a cure period, and reserves the right to terminate. 

Be sure to fill in the bracketed contract clauses and specific failure details before sending.

Highline Milling

[Company Address]  
[Email Address]  

**From:**  
[Your Name / Title]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Your Address]  

**Subject: NOTICE OF MATERIAL BREACH AND SUSPENSION OF PAYMENTS**  
**Contract Reference:** [Agreement Title/Contract ID], dated [Agreement Date] (the "Agreement")

Dear [Contact Name],

This letter serves as formal written notice pursuant to Section [Insert Notice Section, e.g., 12.2] of the Agreement that Highline Milling is in material breach of its contractual obligations to [Your Company Name].

### 1. Specific Grounds for Breach
Under Section [Insert Relevant Section, e.g., 4.1 / Schedule A] of the Agreement, Highline Milling is obligated to [summarize obligation, e.g., meet specified output volumes, maintain required quality standards, adhere to delivery timelines]. Highline Milling has repeatedly and materially failed to fulfill these terms by:

* [Specific breach event 1, e.g., failing to deliver the agreed quota for the billing period ending July 31, 2026];
* [Specific breach event 2, e.g., providing non-conforming materials that fail agreed tolerance specifications];
* [Specific breach event 3, e.g., failure to provide required operational logs or remediate documented deficiencies noted on Date].

These failures constitute an uncured material default under the Agreement.

### 2. Immediate Suspension of Monthly Account Disbursements
In light of this material breach and in accordance with Section [Insert Section or state "applicable commercial law governing performance and reciprocal obligations"], [Your Company Name] has immediately frozen all scheduled disbursements, including the monthly payment of **$85,000.00**, pending resolution of these matters. No further disbursements will be processed until the breaches specified herein are cured to [Your Company Name]’s reasonable satisfaction.

### 3. Demand for Cure and Reservation of Rights
Pursuant to Section [Insert Cure Period Clause, e.g., 30-Day Termination Clause] of the Agreement, Highline Milling has **[e.g., thirty (30)] calendar days** from the receipt of this notice to fully cure the defaults set forth above. 

Failure to cure these breaches within the designated period will result in immediate termination of the Agreement for cause, without further opportunity to cure. 

Nothing contained in this letter shall be construed as a waiver of any rights, remedies, claims, or defenses available to [Your Company Name], all of which are expressly reserved, including but not limited to the right to seek direct, incidental, and consequential damages resulting from Highline Milling’s non-performance.

Please direct your formal written response and proposed remediation plan to the undersigned no later than [Date / Time, e.g., August 29, 2026, at 5:00 PM].

Sincerely,

**[Your Name]**  
[Your Title]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Your Phone Number]  
[Your Email]  

**cc:**  
Vance [Last Name], [Vance’s Title]  
[Company Legal Counsel / Operations File]

Dear [Contact Name],

This letter constitutes formal written notice that Highline Milling is in material breach of the Agreement. Effective immediately, [Your Company Name] has frozen all disbursements to your account, and formal termination proceedings have been initiated.

### 1. Contractual Breaches
Under Section [Insert Relevant Section] of the Agreement, Highline Milling is legally obligated to [summarize obligation]. Highline Milling has materially defaulted on its performance obligations by:

* [Specific failure 1, e.g., failing to deliver contracted production quantities for the period ending July 31, 2026];
* [Specific failure 2, e.g., delivering substandard goods failing quality control thresholds as noted on Date];
* [Specific failure 3, e.g., persisting in unexcused operational delays without adequate remedy].

### 2. Immediate Account and Payment Freeze
As a direct consequence of these material defaults, [Your Company Name] has exercised its right to withhold reciprocal performance. Effective immediately, the recurring monthly disbursement of **$85,000.00** is **FROZEN**. All pending and scheduled accounts payable to Highline Milling are suspended indefinitely. No further funds will be released until all defaults are rectified and verified in writing.

### 3. Ten (10) Day Cure Notice and Termination
Highline Milling is hereby granted **ten (10) calendar days** from the date of this notice—until **September 1, 2026**—to fully cure all outstanding breaches identified above.

If Highline Milling fails to completely remedy these breaches within the ten-day period, the Agreement will **terminate immediately for cause** without further notice. Upon termination, [Your Company Name] will pursue all available remedies at law and equity, including claims for damages, cover costs, and reimbursement for losses caused by your non-performance.

We expect your written response and a complete cure plan no later than [Date/Time, e.g., Monday, August 25, 2026, by 5:00 PM].
